note: Ashcombe Borough Council is fictional. Objectives are the organisation's words. ISO/IEC 27001 text is not copied. Annex identifiers were not checked against a licensed copy.

controls.title: Limit access to people the organisation has authorised
controls.objective: System access is limited to people the organisation has authorised.

controls.title: Remove access when a role ends
controls.objective: System access is removed when a role ends.

controls.title: Log security-relevant events
controls.objective: A person who administers a system records security-relevant events.

controls.title: Report a suspected cyber incident
controls.objective: A suspected cyber incident is reported to the service desk on the same working day.
controls.caf_objective: Minimising the impact of cyber security incidents

controls.title: Back up critical systems and test a restore
controls.objective: A backup is taken and a restore is tested.
controls.caf_objective: Minimising the impact of cyber security incidents

controls.title: Assess a supplier before granting access
controls.objective: A supplier with access to council systems is assessed before the contract is signed.

controls.title: Approve a production change first
controls.objective: A change to a production system is approved before it is made.

controls.title: Give awareness before an account
controls.objective: A person completes information security awareness before an account is issued.
